seo.description: Empowering women to lead, RADIKAL cultivates sovereignty and resilience across Haiti and its diaspora.

sections.heading: Welcome to RADIKAL
sections.body:
a pioneering social enterprise at the intersection of **technology**, **food systems**, and community empowerment.

we are building sustainable futures by investing in **local communities**, fostering economic self-sufficiency, and championing **environmental resilience** in Haiti and beyond.

image.alt: Two women talking at a street food stall, one holding a blue basin

sections.heading: Rooting Livelihoods. Cultivating Sovereignty.
sections.body: Empowering women to lead, RADIKAL cultivates sovereignty and resilience across Haiti and its diaspora. We're transforming communities through sustainable micro-enterprise, planting the seeds for a self-determined future.

sections.heading: The Power of the Madan Sara: The Origin

image.alt: A yellow and grey bird in flight

sections.heading: Our Aspiration. Their Legacy.
sections.body: At RADIKAL, our work is built upon the fierce, indispensable legacy of the Madan Sara; the legendary women traders who serve as the economic and literal backbone of Haiti.
